leads.title: Eastern Caribbean Supreme Court - 29 July 2025 ruling
leads.documents: Strikes down colonial-era buggery and gross indecency laws as unconstitutional; legal basis for same-sex sexual activity being legal since July 2025
leads.detail: Cited as Eastern Caribbean Supreme Court decision of July 29, 2025

leads.title: Saint Lucia Criminal Code (No. 9 of 2004; Effective 1 January 2005), Sections 132-133
leads.documents: Defines offences of Gross Indecency (Sec 132) and Buggery (Sec 133) and post-ruling amendment exempting private consensual adult acts
leads.detail: Cited as No. 9 of 2004; Sec 132 gross indecency, Sec 133 buggery; notes laws were not enforced before being struck down

leads.title: Saint Lucia Labour Code (2006), Article 131
leads.documents: Bans unfair dismissal based on sexual orientation; employment discrimination protection
leads.detail: Cited as Article 131 of the Labour Code, enacted in 2006

leads.title: Saint Lucia Domestic Violence Act - passed 8 March 2022
leads.documents: Extends all domestic violence protections to LGBTQ people
leads.detail: Cited as Domestic Violence Act passed on March 8, 2022

leads.title: UK Upper Tribunal - March 2019 decision
leads.documents: Decided gay men are at risk of persecution in St Lucia and can claim asylum in the United Kingdom; institutional risk assessment
leads.detail: Cited as Upper Tribunal decision March 2019 on asylum risk

leads.title: Eastern Caribbean Alliance for Diversity and Equality (ECADE) and United & Strong - February 2019 statement
leads.documents: Documents murder by stabbing of 27-year-old Guyanese Michael Pooran in Saint Lucia, alleged due to perceived sexual orientation, and urges government to denounce violence/discrimination and re-examine Buggery and Gross Indecency Laws
leads.detail: Cited as February 2019 ECADE and United & Strong response to Pooran murder

leads.title: Minister for Tourism and Civil Aviation Allen Chastanet - 2011 statement
leads.documents: Documents violent attack and robbery of three American gay men in vacation villa by assailants who called them faggots; official apology and statement that destination will not tolerate it
leads.detail: Cited as 2011 apology by Allen Chastanet to three American gay men

leads.title: United and Strong - 2014 human rights sensitisation training and May 2015 follow-up initiative
leads.documents: Documents training of Royal Saint Lucia Police Force on general and LGBT-specific content, extended to Air and Sea Ports, Customs and Corrections; enforcement/rights machinery
leads.detail: Cited as 2014 training success and May 2015 initiative organised by United and Strong

leads.title: External Affairs Minister Sarah Flood-Beaubrun - November 2017 CARIFAM meeting statement
leads.documents: Documents government position to stick to decision to refrain from decriminalising buggery and prostitution despite international pressure
leads.detail: Cited as November 2017 Caribbean Center for Family and Human Rights (CARIFAM) meeting

leads.title: Justice and National Security Minister Hermangild Francis - March 2019 statement
leads.documents: Documents senior government/police official support for review of buggery law, citing maligning of young people because of sexual orientation
leads.detail: Cited as March 2019 statement by Senator Hermangild Francis to reporters
